title: Remote viewing at the Round Table before SRI
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of Remote viewing at the Round Table before SRI, about early 1950s at Round Table Foundation, Rockland, Maine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He's basically doing what would be considered remote viewing.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi says that in the early 1950s, at a private research group called the Round Table Foundation in Rockland, Maine, someone was already doing what would now be called remote viewing: trying to describe faraway places or things with the mind alone. He points to the foundation's research records and to tape recordings made by a man named Puharich. If true, it would mean this kind of mind work was being tried years before the better-known studies at SRI, a California research institute.
